name: PPTX Roundtrip Reproduction
description: Reproduce a PPTX from its extracted design via the shared roundtrip fragment: pptx_extract distills the deck into a PptxDesignProtocol, a document_digest summarizes it, pptx_render writes it back, and the digest is persisted as JSON. Use this for reproduction/round-trip fidelity — authoring new decks goes through media:generate_document with a semantic brief instead. Override paths via --context: {"source_pptx_path": "...", "roundtrip_pptx_path": "...", "digest_path": "..."}.
